stories.title: The US-China tech war has evolved since the last Xi-Trump summit. Who has the edge now?

en.title: The US-China tech war has evolved since the last Xi-Trump summit. Who has the edge now?
en.summary: As US and Chinese presidents prepare to meet in Washington, the two countries' technological and economic rivalry continues to intensify. Huawei Technologies remains a central point of contention in the broader competition between the world's largest economies.

stories.title: Canada’s British Columbia sues OpenAI in US court over school shooting

en.title: Canada's British Columbia sues OpenAI in US court over school shooting
en.summary: British Columbia filed a lawsuit against OpenAI in California, claiming the company failed to report violent activity on ChatGPT by an individual who carried out a mass shooting in a Canadian mining town in February.

stories.title: Top US Senate Democrat Jeanne Shaheen warns Trump not to waver on Taiwan ahead of Xi meet

en.title: Top US Senate Democrat Jeanne Shaheen warns Trump not to waver on Taiwan ahead of Xi meet
en.summary: A senior Democratic senator urged Trump to maintain strong support for Taiwan during his upcoming meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, expressing concern that the president might signal reduced commitment to the island.

stories.title: Why Trump-Xi summit must put Korean peninsula back on the agenda

en.title: Why Trump-Xi summit must put Korean peninsula back on the agenda
en.summary: The upcoming Trump-Xi summit in Washington is expected to address strategic issues beyond economics, raising questions about whether North Korea and the Korean peninsula will receive adequate attention in discussions.

stories.title: UK PM Burnham agrees to Saudi request for refuelling support

en.title: UK PM Burnham agrees to Saudi request for refuelling support
en.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham agreed to provide defensive air-to-air refuelling support to Saudi Arabia for a limited period. The decision follows Saudi requests for assistance amid intensified Houthi attacks on the kingdom.

stories.title: Zelensky and US spy chief Ratcliffe meet in Ireland, sources say

en.title: Zelensky and US spy chief Ratcliffe meet in Ireland, sources say
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met with US CIA Director John Ratcliffe at Shannon Airport in Ireland on Monday. The sources declined to provide details about their conversation.

stories.title: US, Japan and South Korea launch economic-security talks before Xi summit

en.title: US, Japan and South Korea launch economic-security talks before Xi summit
en.summary: The United States, Japan, and South Korea announced a new economic-security consultation framework and reaffirmed their commitment to Taiwan Strait stability. The move precedes a planned summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Donald Trump.

stories.title: Trump’s approval rating falls to career low of 32% as high living costs bite, poll shows

en.title: Trump's approval rating falls to career low of 32% as high living costs bite, poll shows
en.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found US President Donald Trump's approval rating dropped to 32 percent, his lowest on record, as Republicans grew less supportive of his handling of living costs. Republican approval declined from 82 to 73 percent in one week.

stories.title: Trump inaugurates White House helipad but networks skip coverage over media ban

en.title: Trump inaugurates White House helipad but networks skip coverage over media ban
en.summary: President Trump opened a new White House helicopter landing pad on Monday using ceremonial gold scissors. Major television networks, including CNN, declined to cover the event due to restrictions on media access.

stories.title: First charges brought in UK for 1994 Rwanda genocide

en.title: First charges brought in UK for 1994 Rwanda genocide
en.summary: UK prosecutors have charged Vincent Brown, 65, with genocide-related offences following a seven-year investigation. He allegedly directed and incited acts of murder and genocide during the 1994 Rwanda genocide.

stories.title: 欧盟通过延长对俄制裁方案 期限长达三年

en.title: EU extends sanctions against Russia for three years
en.summary: EU member states reached consensus on extending sanctions against Russia for an additional three-year period after lengthy negotiations.

stories.title: “一次登记、全国通用” 解码“数据产权身份证”

en.title: "One registration, nationwide use" decodes "data property rights identity card"
en.summary: A system enabling single registration of data property rights with nationwide applicability has been introduced, creating an identification mechanism for data property ownership.

stories.title: Hong Kong developer New World gets nod to spin off K11 Shanghai assets

en.title: Hong Kong developer New World gets nod to spin off K11 Shanghai assets
en.summary: New World Development received approval from the Shanghai Stock Exchange to spin off and list a real estate investment trust with an expected offering size of 3.82 billion yuan, with the group expecting net proceeds of 3.24 billion yuan.

stories.title: Hong Kong stock exchange moves to ease spin-offs and shareholder approval rules

en.title: Hong Kong stock exchange moves to ease spin-offs and shareholder approval rules
en.summary: The Hong Kong stock exchange proposed relaxing disclosure and shareholder approval requirements for listed companies, including removing profit tests and streamlining spin-off procedures, in a consultation period extending to November 30.

stories.title: How Hong Kong is positioning for a bigger role in Asia’s family wealth transition

en.title: How Hong Kong is positioning for a bigger role in Asia's family wealth transition
en.summary: Hong Kong is strengthening its position as Asia's hub for family business succession and wealth transfer as wealthy families navigate economic uncertainty and generational wealth transitions, according to financial regulators and business executives.

stories.title: Expect ‘high tide’ of Chinese biotech deals as threat of US curbs fades: analysts

en.title: Expect 'high tide' of Chinese biotech deals as threat of US curbs fades: analysts
en.summary: US-China biotech transactions are anticipated to increase significantly as Washington moves away from implementing broad restrictions on such deals. Chinese healthcare companies stand to benefit from this favorable environment combined with Beijing's strategic five-year sector development plan.

stories.title: Asia investors demand AI revenue proof as focus shifts from exposure to earnings: BofA

en.title: Asia investors demand AI revenue proof as focus shifts from exposure to earnings: BofA
en.summary: Asian investors are increasingly requiring concrete evidence that artificial intelligence investments generate actual revenue and earnings rather than merely seeking technology exposure. This shift reflects the sector entering a more mature phase focused on productivity gains and monetization.
